scope: Approved stage1 evidence inspection + stage2 observation response; no stage3 rollout or retraining
selection: Per task, first sorted training episode with separated quarter/three-quarter recorded frames; minimum separation RoboCasa50/ LIBERO10 frames; existing canonical and two training views only
state_response: Canonical view only, actual observations and original demonstration actions. Does not isolate vision from proprioception and does not imply closed-loop performance.
visibility: Qualitative review of actual RGB; not ground-truth semantic segmentation or a proof of equal information. Do not use pixel occupancy alone as evidence sufficiency.
